experience_summary: I have been running for about 2 years now. I have raced 4 half marathons, but I have not run a marthon before.
training_preferences: Include strides 2–3×/week at the end of easy runs
known_limitations: Blew up the last 5 miles of 20‑mile long run on 2026-10-10

fitness_estimates.notes: Athlete reports 2026-10-10 20‑mile long run: approx 580 ft elevation gain; carried ~2 L fluids (refilled with ~3 miles to go); consumed 4 Precision Fuel 30 g gels (120 g) and 2 GU totaling 28 g; took a gel every ~3 miles; total carbs ~148 g (~41 g/hr).
